tests.name: 1. Klassi failid olemas
tests.run: for f in halb.sh parem.sh inventory.ini bootstrap.yml logid/teine_jooks.txt README.md; do test -f "$f" || { echo "PUUDU: $f"; exit 1; }; done; echo OK

tests.name: 3. Päris moodulid: user, package/apt, copy, service; command/shell puudub
tests.run: grep -qE 'user:' bootstrap.yml && grep -qE 'apt:|package:|dnf:' bootstrap.yml && grep -qE 'copy:' bootstrap.yml && grep -qE 'service:|systemd:' bootstrap.yml && ! grep -qE '(command|shell):' bootstrap.yml && echo OK

tests.name: 4. Tõend: teine jooks changed=0
tests.run: grep -q 'PLAY RECAP' logid/teine_jooks.txt && grep -q 'changed=0' logid/teine_jooks.txt && echo OK

tests.name: 5. Tõend: kolm masinat, kõigil changed=0
tests.run: grep -q 'PLAY RECAP' logid/kolm_masinat.txt && test "$(grep -c 'changed=0' logid/kolm_masinat.txt)" -ge 3 && ! grep -qE 'unreachable=[1-9]|failed=[1-9]' logid/kolm_masinat.txt && echo OK

tests.name: 6. Kodutöö: admin.yml (loop, authorized_key), teine jooks changed=0
tests.run: test -f admin.yml && ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini admin.yml --syntax-check >/dev/null && grep -q 'loop' admin.yml && grep -q 'authorized_key' admin.yml && grep -q 'changed=0' logid/admin_teine_jooks.txt && echo OK

tests.name: 7. Kodutöö: hardening.yml (lineinfile, validate, handler), teine jooks changed=0
tests.run: test -f hardening.yml && ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini hardening.yml --syntax-check >/dev/null && grep -q 'lineinfile' hardening.yml && grep -q 'validate' hardening.yml && grep -q 'handlers' hardening.yml && grep -q 'changed=0' logid/hardening_teine_jooks.txt && echo OK

tests.name: 8. Kodutöö: oma/ playbook + README, vastused.md
tests.run: ls oma/*.yml >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -f oma/README.md && test -f vastused.md && echo OK
